source.title: GEPA: Reflective Prompt Evolution Can Outperform Reinforcement Learning
source.where: App. J, Fig. 26 (d) (search tree, validation scores); test scores from Table 1
source.unit: percentage points on the validation set (D_pareto), n = 111
source.spread_basis: assumed, not measured: the paper prints no rerun spread. The range runs from half the binomial standard error at n = 111 validation items to that standard error, at the scores' mean; PUPA's score is a 0 to 100 composite, not a pass rate, so the binomial figure is only the largest standard error a score bounded in [0, 100] with this mean can have, under independent items

held_out.note: the test-set scores the paper prints for the seed and the selected winner: a fresh-task comparison, which is not the estimand (a rerun on the same validation items)

source.note: node ids as printed in the tree; the winner is the tree's top validation score, which matches Fig. 16's test minus generalization gap for this run; the seed's validation score differs across the four runs of this figure (80.15, 80.3, 79.21, 80.75: SD about 0.66 points), an incidental rerun yardstick
